concept.cross_view_consistency_note: Concept inspected: retain connected five-horn/four-bay rhythm, pale sand and teal sea. Correct excessive cliff-like shoreline and sharp promontories to gentle swash-beach slope and low relief. Actual photo shows shallow crescent swash bays, not high eroded cliffs. Bay/horn relief must be encoded in surface height and shoreline coordinates, with no coplanar water overlay. Modestly unequal spacing and skew are allowed; original repeated natural pattern must remain. No foam, separate dune domes, shells or vegetation.
